after_steps.label: Quiz
after_steps.about: Asks what each note means before anything changes.
after_steps.instructions: Read every open note. Ask one question at a time about any note you cannot act on as written.

after_steps.label: Make and walk
after_steps.about: Makes the change for each note and shows it as a walk.
after_steps.instructions: Make the change each note asks for. Record a walk that stops on every changed element, and show it.

after_steps.label: Refresh preview
after_steps.about: Moves your preview onto the change.
after_steps.instructions: Restart the preview on this branch. Ask for approval once it runs the change.

after_steps.label: Ask
after_steps.about: Asks whether anything is left before it delivers.
after_steps.instructions: List each note with what changed for it. Ask for approval with that list.

after_steps.label: Refine and deliver
after_steps.about: Tidies the change and sends it out.
after_steps.instructions: Squash fixups, write the description, and deliver the way you were asked.

changes.after_for_requests: Notes you left on a screen, each answered with a change you walk
